questions.question: Clarify the conference count and numbering: the 2003 school was the First Kolmogorov Readings in a school format; the 2004–2015 meetings were the Second through Thirteenth Readings.

localizations.source: Clarify the conference count and numbering: the 2003 school was the First Kolmogorov Readings in a school format; the 2004–2015 meetings were the Second through Thirteenth Readings.
localizations.ru: Уточнить счёт и нумерацию конференций: школа 2003 года была I Колмогоровскими чтениями в школьном формате; 2004–2015 годы соответствуют II–XIII чтениям.

questions.resolution: The 2003 school is identified as the First Kolmogorov Readings and the 2004–2015 meetings as the Second through Thirteenth; the numbering is confirmed by the package’s bibliographical entry for the Proceedings of the Second Kolmogorov Readings (Yaroslavl, 2004) and the [proceedings of the Thirteenth Readings](https://kolmogorov.yspu.org/wp-content/uploads/sites/3/2016/02/kolmogor13.pdf).
